dsh-mobile-glass 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH Web 移动端适配：窄屏下聊天页在上/侧栏在下的 reveal 抽屉、拖动手势、设置面板底部卡片上滑、composer 与头部修复，桌面端零影响。

posts.en:
dsh-mobile-glass is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI on narrow screens: reveal drawer with the chat layer on top, drag gestures, bottom-sheet settings panel, composer and header fixes, zero desktop impact.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-05c772295ae60d6605de.html
